items.title: For investors with ability – and patience to wait 3 years, not 3 months: 6 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 33%
items.description: The interesting point about the large-cap space today is not that prices have collapsed. In most cases, they have not. The more important change is quieter. Several established businesses are available at valuations that look more reasonable than they did 18 months ago. Their fundamentals have not broken. Their market positions have not disappeared. Their balance sheets have not deteriorated. That is what creates an opportunity.
